title: Egg omelet or scrambled egg with cheese, meat, tomatoes and dark‑green vegetables, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: The dish consists of eggs cooked without added fat, combined with cheese, lean meat, tomatoes and dark‑green vegetables (such as spinach or broccoli). Eggs provide high‑quality protein, while the vegetables and tomatoes add vitamins, minerals and dietary fiber.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Eggs are one of the most nutrient‑dense foods, containing all essential amino acids.
A modest amount of cheese boosts calcium and vitamin D content.
Lean meat (e.g., turkey or chicken breast) adds extra protein without excess fat.
Dark‑green vegetables are rich in lutein and zeaxanthin, beneficial for eye health.
The dish can be prepared on a dry pan, using the natural moisture of the eggs.

items.title: High‑quality protein
items.content: Eggs and meat supply a complete set of amino acids that support tissue growth and repair.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Eggs provide vitamin B12, while meat adds niacin and riboflavin, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Bone support
items.content: Cheese contributes calcium and vitamin D, which help maintain strong bones.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Tomatoes and dark‑green vegetables contain lycopene, lutein and vitamin C, which combat oxidative stress.

items.title: Low added‑fat content
items.content: Cooking without oil reduces overall calories and saturated fat intake.

items.title: Egg allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to egg proteins.

items.title: Cholesterol content
items.content: Egg yolks contain cholesterol; people with hyperlipidemia should monitor yolk consumption.

items.title: Sodium in cheese
items.content: Cheeses can be salty; choose low‑sodium, reduced‑fat varieties when possible.

items.title: Meat quality
items.content: Use fresh, lean meat to avoid the risk of food‑borne infections.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Beat the eggs, then stir in chopped tomatoes, cheese, pre‑cooked meat pieces and finely sliced green vegetables. Pour the mixture onto a pre‑heated dry skillet, cook over medium heat, gently stirring until the eggs set. Serve immediately while hot.

content.title: Storage
content.content: The dish is best enjoyed fresh. If needed, store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours and reheat in a skillet or microwave before serving.
